name: Lumo AI v2.3.1 - Pro Desktop Edition
changelog: Added automated local PKR, wallet & card checkout supporting Safepay and PayFast Pakistan.
Synced desktop upgrade UI directly with cloud Render PostgreSQL + Ed25519 auto-licensing backend.
Removed unnecessary local server port probing when using the cloud gateway and raised checkout timeouts for smooth cold starts.
Includes graphical Windows installer with standard-user setup and SHA-256 verified silent auto-updates.
